consumer_description: Parses markdown content for [[wikilinks]] and resolves bi-directional node connections and backlink references.

rea_evidence.decompiled_snippet: function resolveBacklinks(e, t) { let n = {}; for (let r of e) { let i = parseWikiLinks(r.content); i.forEach(l => { n[l] = n[l] || []; n[l].push(r.id); }); } return n; }
